name: Klaviyo
description: Review Klaviyo campaign performance and prepare campaign changes for review.

methods.label: Sign in with Klaviyo
methods.whenToUse: Connect to the provider-hosted Klaviyo MCP server with browser sign-in.
methods.guidanceMd: Review campaign and metric data, then prepare campaign changes for human review. Campaign write access may expose sends and other state changes; never send or schedule a campaign without explicit authorization and an allowed Paperclip action.

tenantFields.label: Read-only mode
tenantFields.helperMd: Turn on to remove Klaviyo MCP tools that can modify account data. This provider-side restriction is separate from Paperclip action permissions.

warnings: Klaviyo's remote MCP requires an Owner, Admin, or Manager account role.

The campaigns:write toolset may expose campaign sending and other writes. Keep write actions Off until reviewed; the provider's Advanced read-only mode is optional and does not replace Paperclip action permissions.
